      org.apache.catalina.Context.addServletMappingDecoded(String, String, boolean)
      This method will be removed in Tomcat 12. Implementors are expected to implement this method without delegating the implementation to one of the other addServletMapping* methods as that may trigger infinite loops. Once this method has been removed from the interface, implementors may wish to move their implementation of this method to Context.addServletMapping(String, String, boolean) and remove their implementation of this method.
